Consider the following statements about the Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) in India :
1. NBFCs cannot accept demand deposits.
2. All the NBFCs operating in India have to be registered with the RBI.
3. NBFCs form part of the payment and settlement system and can issue cheque drawn on itself.
4. Deposit insurance facility of Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) is not available to the depositors of deposit taking NBFCs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.tagging_note: Topic is unambiguous (NBFCs, ECO-06); confidence is on format only — four statements, no 4-statement slug exists.

independent_answer.reasoning: Statements 1 and 4 are correct per RBI's NBFC FAQs (no demand deposits; DICGC cover unavailable). Statement 2 is false because several categories of NBFC are exempt from RBI registration or are regulated by SEBI/IRDAI/state governments. Statement 3 is false — NBFCs are not part of the payment and settlement system and cannot issue cheques drawn on themselves.

questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) :
1. MPI is calculated using Alkire-Foster methodology.
2. MPI calculated by NITI Aayog has a total of twelve indicators.
3. Maternal Health and Bank Account are common indicators in the MPI of NITI Aayog and MPI of United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.tagging_note: MPI is named in ECO-18; poverty measurement overlap with ECO-17.

independent_answer.reasoning: Statements 1 and 2 are correct (Alkire-Foster methodology; NITI Aayog's National MPI uses 3 dimensions and 12 indicators). Statement 3 is false — Maternal Health and Bank Account are precisely the two extra indicators unique to India's National MPI, absent from the UNDP global MPI's 10 indicators, so they are not common.
